title: Number of readings
task: Set result to the number of rows in readings.

title: Reading columns
task: Set result to the list of column names of readings.

title: Number of devices
task: Set result to the number of rows in devices.

title: Devices per site
task: Set result to a Series of device counts per site (value_counts).

title: Devices per kind
task: Set result to a Series of device counts per kind.

title: Temperature devices
task: Set result to the devices rows where kind == 'temperature'.

title: Readings for device 1
task: Set result to the readings rows where device_id == 1.

title: Average value
task: Set result to the mean of the value column, rounded to 3 decimals (blanks ignored).

title: Max value
task: Set result to the maximum value across all readings, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Min value
task: Set result to the minimum value across all readings, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Missing values
task: Set result to the number of readings with a missing value (an int).

title: Reading hour
task: Set result to readings with an added column hour = the hour of ts.

title: Reading date
task: Set result to readings with an added column day = the date (normalized) of ts.

title: Readings per device
task: Set result to a Series of reading counts per device_id (groupby size).

title: Average value per device
task: Set result to a Series of mean value per device_id, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Average battery
task: Set result to the mean battery level across readings, rounded to 1 decimal.

title: Low battery readings
task: Set result to the number of readings with battery < 20 (an int).

title: Highest readings
task: Set result to the 5 readings with the highest value (reading_id, device_id, value), sorted descending.

title: Value in Fahrenheit
task: Set result to readings with a column value_f = value * 9/5 + 32, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Battery status
task: Set result to readings with a column battery_ok = 1 if battery >= 20 else 0.

title: Distinct devices reporting
task: Set result to the number of distinct device_id values in readings (an int).

title: Earliest timestamp
task: Set result to the earliest ts in readings (a Timestamp).

title: Latest timestamp
task: Set result to the latest ts in readings (a Timestamp).

title: Readings with device kind
task: Set result to readings merged with devices on device_id, keeping reading_id, name, kind, value.

title: Temperature high threshold
task: Set result to the high threshold for kind 'temperature' (a number).

title: Maintenance count
task: Set result to the number of rows in maintenance.

title: Maintenance by action
task: Set result to a Series of maintenance counts per action.

title: Value standard deviation
task: Set result to the standard deviation (ddof=1) of value, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Max value per device
task: Set result to a Series of max value per device_id, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Readings per day
task: Set result to a Series of reading counts per calendar day (ts date), sorted by day.

title: Cold-Store devices
task: Set result to the devices rows where site == 'Cold-Store'.

title: Device number
task: Set result to a Series of the integer after 'SEN-' in each device name.

title: Total readings above 30
task: Set result to the number of readings with value > 30 (an int; blanks are not > 30).

title: Rounded value
task: Set result to readings with a column value_int = value rounded to 0 decimals.
